About — HER STUDIO LONDON 0 Skip to Content HER STUDIO LONDON About Her X Adidas Collabs Social Print Collection Contact Open Menu Close Menu HER STUDIO LONDON About Her X Adidas Collabs Social Print Collection Contact Open Menu Close Menu About Her X Adidas Collabs Social Print Collection Contact HER Studio London HER Studio London is a proud, female led design studio based in East London. HER was launched in 2016 with an ambition to create a platform for work-hard-to-play-hard, independent creatives. The studio produces exclusive artwork for major retailers & contemporary fashion brands around the globe; specialising in Womenswear, Activewear and Swim. Our collective of talented designers work on new briefs every week to ensure that we are able to offer you the most up to date, fresh & exciting interpretations of the latest trends in print & colour. HER designs are recognised for their brave approach & celebration of pattern. Our team produce artworks by hand using a variety of mediums such as tie dye, gouache, watercolour, ink, & pen & pencil detailing. We provide fully digitalised, high resolution PSD files upon purchase. Files can be colour separated & put in to seamless repeat upon your specification. All designs are sold exclusively & have original copyright. It is our mission to create a greener print studio. Behind the scenes, we are working on doing amazing things with our waste; watch this space... A lot of our lovely clients still need to see fabric in person. Wherever possible, if you can, please support our pursuit to focus on digital sales… the world will thank us all later.
